title: Trade Into the Net
setup: Black's king has run to h5 with a lone rook on f5 beside it, and your queen and both rooks are close by.
hint: The defending rook looks like the thing to leave alone. Check what the king's squares become without it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxf5+}} wins the rook with check, {{Qf3+}} drives the king to h4, and {{Rh5#}} is mate with the queen on f3 holding the rook. Capturing the last defender is a hunting move, not a greedy one.
